notes: The IGETC Certificate of Achievement section (Control Number 18118) states only 'Complete all Intersegmental General Education Transfer Curriculum Requirements (Plan C) to a minimum of 34 units' with 'Unit Range for Completion : 34.0 - 34.0'; it prints no course list, so no blocks are recorded.

The certificate is itself a general education pattern (IGETC, Plan C); its 34 units are recorded as total_units, and ge_units is left null to avoid double counting. Reviewer may prefer recording 34 as ge_units.
The area course lists at the top of page 102 (Areas 5A-5C, 6) belong to the preceding program section (Control Number 45619), not to the IGETC certificate; they were not used.
No program learning outcomes or careers are printed for this award.
